::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 28 1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Pusey House PUS 83
:::

My dear [Selina](people/person_1048.qmd)

The Old Solitary Wasp has been excited to write out some recollections of this county in verse which may amuse some of the young Busy Bees.

I enclose my subscription, hoping it is right, but I am not sure

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** With envelope addressed to Miss Moor/ Ampfield Vicarage/ Romsey and postmarked 28 November 1879.  Selina Moor (b. 1859/60) was the daughter of the Rev. John Frewen Moor.  Probably she was the editor of a parish magazine.
